dedupe_keys.name: paleoriada a new integrated spatial database of palaeofloods in spain

description: The Spanish National Research Council and Complutense University of Madrid publish PaleoRiada, a national geographic database of palaeoflood evidence in Spain. It compiles records from journals, book chapters, conference contributions and publicly accessible technical reports. The repository identifies Microsoft Access as the database system and lists a version-four ZIP with a separate reference file. Access is public and free under CC-BY-4.0. The landing metadata does not state the full age range, individual site resolution or database schema, which remain unverified without opening the package. Dating uncertainty, preservation and uneven research coverage limit comparisons of event frequencies. The historical evidence can inform sensitivity checks for extreme-flood scenarios used in dam and flood-defence simulation, not supply a continuous discharge record. PaleoRiada complements instrumental flood series by extending the evidence window. The database and linked reports were not downloaded.
